entities.summary: Walter Scott Palmer is an American former professional basketball player who was selected by the Utah Jazz in the second round of the 1990 NBA draft. A 7'1" center from Dartmouth College, Palmer played two years in the NBA for the Jazz and Dallas Mavericks. In his NBA career, he appeared in a total of 48 games and scored exactly 100 points, averaging 2.1 points per game.
